battle.name: 第二次伊利里亞戰爭
battle.theater: 伊利里亞南部迪馬魯姆與法爾島
battle.brief: 公元前220年，伊利里亞王德米特里奧斯率九十艘輕舟越利蘇斯，突襲皮洛斯、掠奪基克拉澤斯，並攻陷羅馬盟友城市，逼羅馬在迦太基大戰前清理亞得里亞；前219年執政官埃米利烏斯·保盧斯七日攻下迪馬魯姆，再於法爾島兩路登陸夾擊守軍，德米特里奧斯逃往馬其頓。卡面希臘重步兵屬前世紀方陣傳統。

kit.name: 希臘重步兵
kit.history: 方陣的重心不是個人，是互相遮蔽。盾牌接在一起時，一支軍隊的正面比一個人結實。

countries: 這場戰爭是公元前220年至前218年間，羅馬共和國與亞得里亞海東岸伊利里亞王國（阿爾迪亞伊聯盟）之間的正面衝突。交戰雙方都不是近代意義上的國家，而是以城邦聯盟與部落聯盟為骨架的政治體。羅馬一方由元老院指派公元前219年的兩位執政官統兵，其中以盧基烏斯·埃米利烏斯·保盧斯居主導地位；兵員為兩支部隊，每支約四千二百至四千五百名步兵、三百名騎兵，另有拉丁盟邦與意大利盟邦提供的輔兵分遣隊，以及一支由列槳戰船組成、負責封鎖海峽與港口的艦隊，指揮系統以執政官為最高，輔以營務官與百夫長，並隨軍配備工程人員與攻城工匠。伊利里亞一方以法爾島的國王德米特里奧斯為核心，透過婚姻接管阿格隆家族的攝政權，控制阿爾迪亞伊、德里斯塔、阿廷塔尼等部落，另在亞得里亞海北端與希斯特里人結盟；兵力以部落徵召的步兵、少量騎兵與一支由九十艘輕舟組成的艦隊為主，並曾以伊利里亞分遣隊遠征希臘，與馬其頓王菲利普五世、埃托利亞聯盟及阿塔曼尼王阿米納斯保持同盟關係，其指揮系統以王命直轄的將領為核心，輔以各部落的本地首領。整場衝突沒有第三國以正式交戰方身分介入，羅馬與伊利里亞始終直接對壘。
countriesEn: The Second Illyrian War was a direct collision between the Roman Republic and the Illyrian Kingdom on the eastern Adriatic, fought between 220 and 218 BC. Neither side was a state in the modern sense: both were political structures built on city leagues and tribal confederations. On the Roman side the Senate appointed the two consuls of 219 BC, and Lucius Aemilius Paullus took the leading role. The field army was made up of two consular columns, each of roughly 4,200 to 4,500 foot and 300 horse, with contingents supplied by the Latin League and by the Italian allies, together with a fleet of oared warships charged with blocking the straits and the harbours. Command ran from the consuls downward, assisted by quaestors and centurions, and engineers and siege craftsmen marched with the column. On the Illyrian side the pivot was Demetrius of Pharos, king of the Ardiaean confederacy, who had taken over the regency of Agron's dynasty by marriage and who held sway over the Ardiaei, the Daorsi and the Atintani; in 221 BC he also allied himself with the Histri at the head of the Adriatic. His forces were the levies of those tribes, a small number of horsemen, and a fleet of ninety light galleys, and detachments of Illyrians served abroad in Greece. He kept alliances with Philip V of Macedon, with the Aetolian League and with Amynas, king of the Athamanes, and his command system centred on generals appointed by the king, with the local chiefs of each tribe beneath them. No third state entered the war as a formal belligerent: the confrontation stayed face to face between Rome and the Illyrians.
people: 德米特里奧斯·法羅斯是這場衝突的核心人物。他在女王提烏塔統治伊利里亞時已是領兵大將，前229年的第一次伊利里亞戰爭後被羅馬赦免，並以使節身分前往羅馬，以友邦之名取得羅馬的保護與一份贈禮。返回伊利里亞後，他約於前222年迎娶阿格隆的前妻特里泰烏塔，成為幼主皮涅斯的攝政，王國內部的矛盾因此暫時平息；他同時與馬其頓重建關係，前222年塞拉西亞之戰中率一千六百名伊利里亞人隸於馬其頓方陣麾下，戰後轉而在亞得里亞沿海擴張勢力。前220年，他與伊利里亞將領斯爾狄利達斯率九十艘輕舟南下，攻入伯羅奔尼撒與愛琴海；斯爾狄利達斯的妻兄、阿塔曼尼王阿米納斯勸他加入埃托利亞聯盟對阿開亞的行動，兩人在庫奈塔依靠內應開城得手，在克利托爾受挫。德米特里奧斯於前219年據守法爾島，面對羅馬遠征軍的兩路登陸，兵敗後拋下軍隊逃往馬其頓王宮，尋求菲利普五世的庇護，直到死後仍被羅馬要求引渡而遭拒。羅馬方面的關鍵人物是執政官埃米利烏斯·保盧斯，他主導攻取迪馬魯姆與法爾島之戰，三年後卻在坎尼會戰中陣亡；被扶植的皮涅斯則以附庸國王的身份留下，向羅馬繳交戰後罰款。波利比奧斯、阿庇安與卡西烏斯·狄奧的殘篇，是今日重建這段經過的主要來源。
peopleEn: The figure at the centre of the conflict was Demetrius of Pharos. He had already been a leading commander under Queen Teuta in Illyria, was pardoned by Rome after the First Illyrian War of 229 BC, and travelled to Rome as an envoy, returning with Roman protection, a gift and the standing of a friend. Back in Illyria he married Triteuta, Agron's former wife, around 222 BC, and became regent for the boy-king Pinnes, which quieted the internal friction of the kingdom. At the same time he rebuilt ties with Macedon: in 222 BC he led 1,600 Illyrians at Sellasia, serving in the Macedonian phalanx, and afterwards turned to expand his hold along the Adriatic coast. In 220 BC Demetrius and the Illyrian commander Scerdilaidas took ninety light galleys south of Lissus and struck into the Peloponnese and the Aegean. Amynas, king of the Athamanes and Scerdilaidas' brother-in-law, urged him to join the Aetolians' planned offensive; the two men took Cynaetha by treachery before being checked at Cleitor. Demetrius held Pharos against the Roman expedition in 219 BC, was broken by the two-sided Roman landing, abandoned his army and fled to the court of Philip V of Macedon, where he remained as a dependent guest and was never handed over despite repeated Roman demands. The decisive Roman figure was the consul Aemilius Paullus, who directed the reduction of Dimallum and the campaign on Pharos, and who was killed three years later at Cannae. Pinnes was left on the throne as a client king paying the war indemnity. The reconstruction of these events rests chiefly on the surviving pages of Polybius, Appian and Cassius Dio.
kits: 卡面這件兵器是公元前500年前後成形於希臘城邦的希臘重步兵：圓形盾牌（aspis）、約兩公尺半的長矛（dory）、短刺劍、青銅頭盔，以及亞麻或皮製的鱗甲（linothorax）。它代表的是五至四世紀希臘方陣的核心：盾牌接合為連續弧面，後排矛尖越過前排肩頭刺出，士兵的體力被軍隊吸收。必須坦白說明，這場戰爭的戰報裡沒有出現希臘式重裝步兵成建制投入的記載；到前220年，希臘城邦的步兵主力已轉為持方盾的輕裝兵與投槍兵，馬其頓菲利普五世麾下的長槍方陣才是當時重步兵的形態，而它正是hoplite方陣的直系後身。德米特里奧斯的伊利里亞軍隊以另一種方式延續了同一原理：圓形或橢圓形小盾交疊成密集的實心盾牆，配備兩公尺以上的標槍、雙刃短劍、青銅或獸皮頭盔與投石索，並以九十艘吃水淺、單列划槍、可快速靠岸的輕舟作戰平台。海上對抗的主體是羅馬的列槳戰船與伊利里亞的輕舟；陸戰羅馬方面是典型的軍團裝備，大型橢圓盾（scutum）、標槍（pilum）、短劍（gladius）、甲片互相扣連的裝甲，以及為強攻迪馬魯姆而集中的雲梯、撞槌與工程器材。埃托利亞與阿塔曼尼的同盟軍以輕裝兵與投石手見長，馬其頓方則是長槍方陣。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the Greek hoplite as it had taken shape in the city states around 500 BC: the round aspis shield, a dory about two and a half metres long, the short xiphos sword, a bronze helmet and a corselet of linen or hide (linothorax). It stands for the core of the Greek phalanx of the fifth and fourth centuries: shields locked into a continuous curve, the spears of the rear rank projecting over the shoulders of the rank in front, the strength of individual men absorbed into the strength of the formation. It must be said plainly that no surviving account of this war shows Greek-style heavy infantry deployed in formed units. By 220 BC the main body of Greek infantry had become peltasts and thureophoroi, light troops with small square shields, while the true heavy infantry of the age was Philip V's Macedonian sarissa phalanx, the direct heir of the hoplite phalanx. Demetrius' Illyrians carried the same principle forward in another form: small round or oval shields overlapped into a dense solid wall, backed by javelins of more than two metres, double-edged swords, bronze or leather helmets and slings, with ninety shallow-draught, single-banked galleys to carry the fighting. The maritime contest pitted Roman oared warships against those light galleys; on land the Roman column carried the standard legion kit of the large oval scutum, the pilum, the gladius, articulated armour, and the ladders, battering rams and engineering equipment concentrated for the assault on Dimallum. The Aetolian and Athamanian contingents were light infantry and slingers, while the Macedonian side fought in the sarissa phalanx.
tactics: 伊利里亞的戰法是海陸兩線同時動手。海上以九十艘輕舟集群出擊，避開羅馬的巡邏，採取夜間接近、箭雨壓制、隨即靠岸登船的掠奪式戰法：前220年他們奇襲皮洛斯，奪走五十艘船，又在科林斯東面的辛克里亞停泊；斯爾狄利達斯另率四十艘船駛入科林斯灣，在庫奈塔依靠內應夜間開城，縱火焚城，隨後攻擊克利托爾失利。馬其頓的科林斯指揮官陶里翁更策劃把德米特里奧斯的五十艘船用人力拖過科林斯地峽，讓伊利里亞艦隊突然出現在科林斯灣，再以同盟資格加入對埃托利亞人的戰爭。陸戰上，德米特里奧斯集結的軍隊以重疊的盾牆形成實心方陣，兩翼配置騎兵，這正是馬其頓長槍方陣與伊利里亞方陣共有的戰法。羅馬的反制則是純粹的工程與兩面夾擊：遠征軍先以圍城器材強攻迪馬魯姆，七日內破城；攻法爾島時主力趁夜由另一處登陸到樹林地帶，同時派小股船隊到城下挑釁，引德米特里奧斯率兵出城迎戰，待伊利里亞軍隊離開城牆、主力自林中出現，羅馬軍隊即從兩側夾擊，切斷退路；其後封鎖港口、拆毀城防，迫使守軍投降。從後勤看，羅馬以艦隊保障給養、以近距離登陸作戰、把戰場推到對方島嶼，與德米特里奧斯四處劫掠、以掠奪所得維持艦隊的做法正好相反。
tacticsEn: The Illyrians fought on two lines at once, by sea and by land. At sea they sailed in a cluster of ninety light galleys, slipped past the Roman patrols and worked by their old raiding method: close in at night, put an arrow storm across the target, and put their men ashore. In 220 BC they surprised Pylos, took fifty ships and lay in at Cenchreae, the eastern port of Corinth. Scerdilaidas took forty ships into the Gulf of Corinth, carried Cynaetha by opening the gate with traitors at night and burning the town, and was then checked in his attack on Cleitor. Taurion, the Macedonian commander at Corinth, planned the hauling of Demetrius' fifty ships bodily across the Isthmus, so that the Illyrian fleet would appear suddenly in the Gulf of Corinth and enter the war against the Aetolians as an ally. On land the army Demetrius gathered formed a solid mass with overlapping shields, with horsemen on the flanks, the same doctrine that the Macedonian sarissa phalanx and the Illyrian phalanx shared. The Roman answer was pure engineering and pincers. The expedition first took Dimallum by assault with the siege equipment, breaking the place inside seven days. Against Pharos the main body landed by night in a wooded part of the island while a small force of ships was sent out to provoke Demetrius into marching down from his fortifications; when the Illyrians were away from the walls and the Roman main body appeared from the trees, the Roman troops attacked on two sides and cut the line of retreat. Then the harbour was sealed, the fortifications demolished, and the garrison compelled to surrender. Logistically the two sides ran on opposite principles: Rome kept its supplies safe with the fleet, fought from close range, and carried the battlefield onto the enemy's own island, while Demetrius lived on plunder and used raids to keep his galleys manned.
data: 可核對的數字集中在幾個節點。前222年，德米特里奧斯率一千六百名伊利里亞人參與塞拉西亞之戰，這支部隊是文獻中伊利里亞人最明確的一次成建制外調。前220年南下時，他與斯爾狄利達斯共率九十艘輕舟；奇襲皮洛斯後奪走五十艘船，斯爾狄利達斯另帶四十艘進入納夫帕克圖斯，德米特里奧斯則以五十艘船進入愛琴海，勒索基克拉澤斯群島。前219年，他抽調最精銳的六千人駐守法爾島，島上城防與糧秣齊備；同一年羅馬軍在七日內攻下迪馬魯姆，隨後以兩路登陸擊潰守軍，到前218年守軍投降。羅馬方的前219年執政官軍由兩支部隊組成，每支約四千二百至四千五百名步兵、三百名騎兵，合計約一萬步兵、六百騎兵，另有盟邦輔兵與艦隊。對照第一次伊利里亞戰爭，波利比奧斯記載羅馬當時出動二百二十艘戰船、七千步兵與五百騎兵，並在狹水道一役損失數十艘；前228年的和約限制伊利里亞王只能保有兩艘船、不得再向他國征收保護費，前221年羅馬艦隊還曾以戰爭回應德米特里奧斯與希斯特里人的結盟。這些數字說明，羅馬用大約兩倍的兵力和遠多於對手的船隻，換取了伊利里亞在亞得里亞海的航運能力。
dataEn: The verifiable figures cluster around a few moments. In 222 BC Demetrius led 1,600 Illyrians at the battle of Sellasia, the clearest case in the sources of Illyrians deployed as a formed contingent abroad. When he sailed south in 220 BC he and Scerdilaidas commanded ninety light galleys between them; after the surprise at Pylos they took fifty ships, Scerdilaidas entered Naupactus with forty, and Demetrius carried fifty vessels into the Aegean to extort tribute from the Cyclades. In 219 BC he posted 6,000 of his best men on Pharos, where the fortifications, stores and provisions were all in good order. In the same year the Roman army took Dimallum in seven days, broke the Illyrian garrison with a two-sided landing, and by 218 BC the defenders had surrendered. The Roman consular force of 219 BC was two columns of roughly 4,200 to 4,500 foot and 300 horse each, about 10,000 foot and 600 horse in all, plus allied contingents and the fleet. For comparison, Polybius records that in the First Illyrian War Rome put 220 warships, 7,000 foot and 500 horse to sea, and lost dozens of ships in the fighting in the narrows. The settlement of 228 BC limited the Illyrian king to two vessels and forbade him any further exaction of protection money from other peoples, and in 221 BC a Roman fleet had already answered Demetrius' alliance with the Histri with war. These numbers show the shape of the contest: Rome bought control of the Illyrian lanes in the Adriatic with roughly double the manpower and far more shipping than the enemy could field.
cause: 直接起因是德米特里奧斯在羅馬眼中越界。前229至前228年的第一次伊利里亞戰爭後，羅馬以武力拆散提烏塔的女王體系，並於前228年訂下和約：伊利里亞人不得再劫掠羅馬的盟友與商船，王室船隻數目受限制，也不得再向他國征收保護費。戰後德米特里奧斯被羅馬當作友邦留下，此後十年間雙方相安無事。但前225至前222年羅馬把主力壓在波河平原對付凱爾特人，無暇北顧，德米特里奧斯便趁機重整王國：迎娶特里泰烏塔、接管攝政、與馬其頓修好，又把阿廷塔尼人從羅馬同盟中拉走，率艦南下利蘇斯恢復海盜行徑，前221年更與亞得里亞海北端的希斯特里人結盟，騷擾羅馬的糧運船隊。前220年，馬其頓與亞該亞聯盟結盟對抗埃托利亞聯盟，希臘雙方都在忙於備戰，德米特里奧斯於是把艦隊投入希臘：在皮洛斯奪船，焚庫奈塔，掠奪基克拉澤斯，甚至讓船隊經科林斯地峽轉入海灣，此舉同時衝擊埃托利亞與馬其頓在地中海的航運。回到亞得里亞後，他又在隨後的冬天攻陷羅馬盟友的城市與聚落。羅馬本來正準備對迦太基開戰，而亞得里亞海是意大利最要緊的糧道與兵源通道；元老院決定先把阿爾迪亞伊沿岸的港口弄安全，第二次伊利里亞戰爭就此被挑起。
causeEn: The immediate cause was that Demetrius overstepped in Roman eyes. After the First Illyrian War of 229 to 228 BC Rome had broken up Queen Teuta's regime by force and imposed a settlement in 228 BC: the Illyrians were to raid neither Roman allies nor Roman traders, the number of royal vessels was restricted, and no protection money was to be exacted from other peoples. Demetrius was then left alone as a friend of Rome, and for a decade the two sides lived in peace. But from 225 to 222 BC Rome was pinning its strength against the Celts in the Po plain and could not look north, and Demetrius used that opening to rebuild his kingdom: he married Triteuta, assumed the regency, made his peace with Macedon, detached the Atintani from their Roman alliance, ran his squadrons south of Lissus and resumed piracy, and in 221 BC joined the Histri at the head of the Adriatic, interfering with Roman supply traffic. In 220 BC, with Macedonia newly allied to the Achaean League against the Aetolian League and both Greek sides arming, Demetrius threw his fleet into Greece: he took ships at Pylos, burned Cynaetha, plundered the Cyclades, and even had his vessels carried across the Isthmus of Corinth to strike at the Aetolian coast, hitting the seaborne trade of the Aetolians and of Macedon at once. Back on the Adriatic, he seized Roman-allied towns and communities during the following winter. Rome was already preparing for its war with Carthage, and the Adriatic was the most important grain and man-power route for Italy; the Senate decided that the harbours of the Ardiaean coast had to be made secure, and the Second Illyrian War was precipitated.
impact: 戰爭直接改變了亞得里亞海兩岸的權力結構。羅馬得到前一次戰爭的全部成果，並在法爾島拆毀城防，把阿爾迪亞伊的海岸據點重新握在掌心；伊利里亞原有的王國則被拆解，德米特里奧斯淪為馬其頓的依附者，羅馬要求引渡他、菲利普五世拒絕，此後皮涅斯的小王國虛弱不堪，靠繳交戰後罰款維持地位，很快落入馬其頓的勢力範圍，原有的部落聯盟則被一批城市聯盟取代，例如帕爾提尼、比利內斯、阿曼提尼等。羅馬從此把控制亞得里亞海視為海外擴張的前提；卡西烏斯·狄奧留下的殘篇記錄了羅馬人把這批戰利品抬入城的場面，元老院的邏輯很清楚：要在迦太基打仗，先得處理伊利里亞。在希臘世界，埃托利亞聯盟在庫奈塔得手卻在阿開亞與科林斯地峽一線受挫，馬其頓得以把勢力伸入伯羅奔尼撒，亞該亞聯盟則在希臘中部重新站穩；伊利里亞艦隊在辛克里亞與地峽之間的折騰，也顯示前3世紀初地中海的海權爭奪已經跨出義大利。此外，這場戰爭把羅馬海軍推到亞得里亞北岸的舞台中央，後來羅馬在第二次布匿戰爭中得以從海路向西班牙與北非調兵，前219年的遠征等於先把北翼的門打開。
impactEn: The war rearranged the balance of power on both shores of the Adriatic. Rome kept everything it had won in the previous conflict, demolished the fortifications of Pharos and once more held the coastal strongholds of the Ardiaei. The Illyrian kingdom was broken up: Demetrius became a dependent of Macedon, Rome demanded his extradition and Philip V refused, and the small state of Pinnes survived only as a client paying war indemnities, soon falling into the Macedonian sphere of influence, while the old tribal leagues were replaced by a set of urban koina such as the Parthini, the Byllines and the Amantini. From then on Rome treated command of the Adriatic as a precondition for overseas expansion. The surviving fragments of Cassius Dio record the booty from this war being carried into the city, and the logic of the Senate was plain: to make war on Carthage, Illyria had to be settled first. In the Greek world the Aetolian League won at Cynaetha but was checked in Achaea and around the Isthmus, Macedon extended its influence into the Peloponnese, and the Achaean League re-established itself in central Greece; the gymnastics of the Illyrian fleet between Cenchreae and the Isthmus showed that the struggle for command of the Mediterranean had already moved beyond Italy. The war also put the Roman navy on the stage of the northern Adriatic, and that is why Rome could later move men to Spain and North Africa by sea in the Second Punic War: the expedition of 219 BC had first opened the northern door.
result: 結果是羅馬的完全勝利，而且節奏快得驚人。前219年，遠征軍先以七日強攻拿下迪馬魯姆，沿岸各城隨即歸順羅馬保護；接著攻擊法爾島，德米特里奧斯自恃城堅糧足、兵力精銳，不料羅馬主力在島上樹林處登陸、以小船挑釁誘他出城，結果在離開城牆之後遭兩面夾擊，隊伍崩潰；到前218年守軍投降，國王拋下法爾島逃往馬其頓，島上城防隨即被羅馬拆毀，執政官在夏末回到羅馬接受祝賀，並以凱旋式慶祝這場勝利。伊利里亞方面則失去艦隊、領土與能打的將領：德米特里奧斯此後只以馬其頓賓客的姿態活動，羅馬屢次要求引渡，菲利普五世一直拒絕；皮涅斯則被留在王位上，必須繳清戰前拖欠的貢賦與戰後罰款。整場戰爭從前220年的皮洛斯掠奪到前218年的投降，只用大約兩年，羅馬以遠少於對手的兵力和兩倍的軍團換來亞得里亞海航路的控制，並把前一次戰爭的成果牢牢釘在阿波羅尼亞與法爾島兩個支點上；它也因此成為第二次布匿戰爭前夜，羅馬在東方唯一一場速戰速決的戰役。
resultEn: The outcome was a complete Roman victory, and it came remarkably fast. In 219 BC the expedition first took Dimallum by a seven-day assault, and the coastal towns then submitted to Roman protection one after another. The attack on Pharos followed: Demetrius, confident in his walls, his supplies and his picked troops, did not expect the Roman main body to land in the woods of the island and to be drawn out of his fortifications by a small force of ships, and once he had left the walls he was attacked on both sides and his army broke. By 218 BC the garrison had surrendered, the king deserted Pharos and fled to Macedon, the fortifications of the island were promptly dismantled, and before the end of the summer the consul was back in Rome receiving congratulations and celebrating the victory with a triumph. Illyria lost its fleet, its territory and its best commanders: Demetrius from then on appears only as a guest at the Macedonian court, Rome demanded his extradition again and again, and Philip V kept refusing; Pinnes was left on his throne, obliged to pay off the tribute in arrears and the war indemnity. From the raid on Pylos in 220 BC to the surrender in 218 BC the whole war took about two years. Rome bought control of the Adriatic lanes with fewer men than the enemy could muster and with double the number of legions, and it nailed down the results of the previous war at two anchors, Apollonia and Pharos. It was also the one swift, decisive campaign Rome fought in the east on the eve of the Second Punic War.
